# Blackline 0.15.102

* **Presence without connecting.** The app no longer dials every friend to find out who is online. Each device publishes one small "I'm here" record a minute; the rows on your screen are looked up, nothing else. A link is made only when you open a conversation, a call is up, or a message is owed. Measured: friends on screen, nothing open — zero connections.
* **Links in chat open in your browser**, not inside the app.
* The desktop notification carries the logo at a proper size.
